days.label: Saturday
days.text: Saturday is stacked. Our own BTown Coffee Club [MEETUP] holds down Zero Gravity on Pine Street from 10, free as always, come say hi. Families have options all day, with a Family Bike Ride to Oakledge rolling from the Local Motion Trailside Center at 10, the Princess Cruise sailing the Spirit of Ethan Allen at noon with fairy tale characters aboard, and Field Day & Kites in the Park filling Veterans Memorial Park in South Burlington from 1 to 3 with kite making and sack races. The Corn Roast & Car Show parks the Champlain Valley Street Rodders at Sam Mazza's in Colchester from 10 to 4 with 1950s rock and roll on the speakers. Shelburne has the big one, the VTB & VFC Birthday Bash at the Vermont Teddy Bear factory, a free daytime party from 11 to 3 with mini golf and a bouncy castle, then a ticketed evening ($15-$20) from 5 to 9 with DJ Fattie B and a sunset drone light show. The evening lineup runs deep, with teen soul standouts MINC playing their Summertime Bash at the SEABA Center at 7 on a $15-$30 sliding scale, the Vermont Comedy Awards handing out hardware free at Vermont Comedy Club at 6, the documentary Frequency premiering at Main Street Landing with doors at 6:30, mentalist Dr. Steve Taubman's Mind Magic ($35) at the Off Center at 7:30, dance theater piece Shadowlight at the McCarthy Arts Center in Colchester at 7, and Bop To The Top closing the night at Higher Ground at 9.

days.label: Sunday
days.text: Sunday leads with the Lake Champlain Dragon Boat Festival , paddlers filling Waterfront Park from 8 to 4 in support of Dragonheart Vermont's programs for breast cancer survivors. The Vermont Brass Trio plays free among the galleries at the BCA Center at 10, and master naturalist Gene O. Desideraggio leads a Tree ID and Natural History Tour of Ethan Allen Park at 10, preregistration required. Book people can catch Helen Whybrow celebrating the paperback of The Salt Stones at Phoenix Books from 1 to 3, free with preregistration. And with the humidity breaking, ska veterans Save Ferris close the weekend at Higher Ground at 8 with Vallory Falls opening.
